nodes.applies_when: Route explicit existing Source List edits and deletes to edit_measure_source_lists and delete_measure_source_lists before create normalization; never create rows in those branches. Normalize an add/create data lookup or source-list request for an existing measure, including supplied source-list Name and IsDefault with or without an explicit List selection, to standalone_source_list_load. Treat the existing measure name as the parent identity and the source-list Name as the new child value. Select one requested Planning Measure, measure catalog, group, granularity, level, or source-list branch and require its inputs; for combined requests invoke branches separately with resolved identities. Complete each read-only lookup without implicitly running other branches. Before any selected branch, require active project and Run Book context, exact task identity, the workflow-selected environment and client, required inputs and declared operation; apply the Fusion-enforced authorization policy in ora_design_enforcement.md. Preserve existing workflow environment/account, OAuth/session and operation checks. Apply the optional Privilege evidence preflight policy in ora_design_enforcement.md under its recorded task-scoped user exception. Missing grant records, manual review or privilege mappings must not select missing or block source preparation, preview or submission; continue the selected branch with ordinary workflow checks. Do not claim unassessed privileges are verified. Known denied access or an actual authorization failure selects missing to CPA.LOOKUP_FAILURE with authorization_or_privilege and the exact cause; no write or automatic mutation retry. Caller core.runbook owns cross-task coordination. Unsupported CSV export/import stays blocked unless live metadata or source guidance confirms support through the selected workflow. The Data Loader and runbook approval workflows own their execution; another mutating route requires exact-environment/payload approval immediately before execution. Lookup results never authorize a write. Complete supported pagination, distinguish a failed or incomplete lookup from an empty set, resolve exactly one requested identity, never select the first partial result, and stop after the requested branch. Returned item links are evidence and may be used only through the declared resolver; do not switch the initial request to an archived rv revision. Keep reusable outputs free of tenant URLs, audit identities, ETags and sensitive values; persist sanitized durable results, classified diagnostics, skill runs and token usage through the declared project services and manifest paths. A missing workflow, client, payload contract or approval is a blocker, never a reason to substitute another route. Route registered planningMeasures and planningMeasureSourceLists imports through core.data-loader and an approved planningMeasures parent delete through core.data-loader; the REST client supplies only its declared read-only delete preflight evidence. For create_planning_measure, check the supplied Measure Catalog selection locally before choosing the create branch: omitted, blank, or empty selects missing_measure_catalog and stops with input_validation and Creation blocked: a valid Measure Catalog is required; ask no question. A nonblank selection continues to the existing validator and live catalog-resolution rules. A duplicate-origin fresh create may rely on validated copied non-seeded catalog associations. Stop on unsupported or missing inputs; do not infer a generic catalogs route.

When a measure-create request supplies Expression or EditLockExpr, execute this POST before preparing the create source. This node is the task-specific POST execution contract for this BO even though the shared action catalog labels its Fusion REST route reference_lookup. Use the task-specific general REST endpoint against the selected environment's configured restBaseUrl; do not infer availability from Data Loader registration. Invoke this BO as a validation POST, never as a GET lookup: use the workflow-selected core.fusion-api.rest-api-client to POST /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/planningMeasureValidateExpressions separately for each supplied Expression and EditLockExpr. Send JSON MeasureId null or empty, target Name, and exact text in Expression; send EditLockExpr text in Expression for its call. Inspect the Fusion response body regardless of HTTP status, including an HTTP error body exposed by the client. Read nonempty o:errorDetails[].detail strings, or a plain server message when no JSON detail is present; unwrap the client HTTP error prefix before comparing the server message. Pass only when every returned server message is exactly Expression is valid, with no conflicting message; skip only when neither field is requested. Display any other returned server message verbatim and stop. A transport failure without a readable server message or an empty or unreadable response blocks submission. Preserve each successful result and exact text for the immutable create payload; do not substitute local syntax checks, archives, or Data Loader source validation.
A MeasureId or Name is supplied, or planning measures must be reviewed; use find_planning_measure_by_id_or_name
A GroupId or GroupName is supplied, or planning measure groups must be reviewed; use find_planning_measure_group_by_id_or_name
Measures assigned to a selected planning measure group must be reviewed; use list_planning_measures_in_group

For find_planning_measure_catalog_by_name, require a nonblank exact catalog Name, GET the declared planningMeasureCatalogs collection through the selected read-only Fusion client, complete all pages, and return CatalogId only for exactly one exact Name match. Missing, ambiguous, malformed, or incomplete results block selection; no write.

Use resolve_measure_levels_from_granularity on the documented GET /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/granularityLevels collection with q=GranularityId%3D{GranularityId}; require one exact item and ordered level-name/ID pairs. Never send granularityLevels_Id.

For a create request, use levels_supplied when one or more ordered measure levels are supplied. Otherwise use levels_missing with a supplied positive integer GranularityId, or default GranularityId to 135 when neither input was supplied. An explicitly supplied invalid level list or GranularityId is invalid; do not replace it with 135. For a duplicate-origin Project or Planning Attribute handoff explicitly resolved through CPA.RESOLVE_DUPLICATE_DEFAULT_LEVELS, choose levels_supplied with the full context-level projection and retained Default subset; the context-specific GranularityId is lookup evidence, not a reason to select the parent-granularity branch. For any other duplicate-origin create handoff with an authoritative source GranularityId, choose levels_missing with that exact source value so the declared granularity lookup validates the copied dimensionality; supplied copied levels are comparison evidence, not a reason to discard the source granularity. Do not apply the ordinary default to a duplicate. If preservation is unsupported, levels_supplied is allowed only for the separately verified equivalent level-based projection.

Resolve exact ordered level identities first. When Measure Context is supplied, resolve it through list_planning_measure_contexts and validate all supplied DimensionId/LevelId pairs against that context using list_planning_measure_levels_by_context and its returned DimensionLevels links; do not require Default classification before selected-context validation. When context is omitted, check Default first. If all levels are Default-eligible select context 1. Otherwise retain those levels and check the remaining levels against each non-Default context returned by list_planning_measure_contexts; select a context only when exactly one supports the remaining levels and the complete supplied set validates in that context. If multiple contexts match, present their names and IDs and explicitly ask the user to select one; do not continue until the selection is supplied and validated. No matching context requires clarification. After selecting context 2 or 3, classify Default-eligible levels for the required LevelsList subset, retaining the complete ordered list in the selected context list. Preserve resolved duplicate-context evidence and the existing CTO Default-eligibility exception. Complete every applicable page; failed, ambiguous, malformed, incomplete, or missing-link results remain blockers. Never discard levels or change source order.

Apply the supplied-level Measure Context Standard Default only after complete Default eligibility classification. If context is omitted and all supplied levels are Default-eligible, use MeasureContextId 1 (Default), carry MeasureContext 1 into the create source, and continue without asking for context. If any level is non-Default and context is omitted, accept only the unique context resolved through the completed context and level lookups in CPA.CLASSIFY_SUPPLIED_DEFAULT_LEVELS; ask for context if none or multiple contexts match. Do not guess from level names. Preserve an explicitly supplied context, including a resolved duplicate context projection, require 1, 2, or 3, and retain the selected context for subsequent level validation under the existing input and lookup contracts; do not perform live lookups in this defaulting node. Preserve the full source order and all levels. The GranularityId branch keeps its existing context resolution and does not enter this node.

When measure levels are absent, use the supplied positive integer GranularityId or the default 135 selected only when both inputs were absent. Resolve it through resolve_measure_levels_from_granularity on the documented granularityLevels collection with q=GranularityId%3D{GranularityId}. Take MeasureContextId from the same exact item; require 1, 2, or 3 and do not prompt for context. A supplied conflicting context is invalid. Never send granularityLevels_Id; HTTP 400 or no response is failure, not not_found. For duplicate origin, resolve the exact authoritative source GranularityId without default substitution. Carry it into the final create source when live schema and selected-adapter support are verified; compare any copied levels/context with the returned definition and block a conflict. Resolution does not authorize clearing the preserved duplicate granularity. For a create whose level source is an explicitly supplied GranularityId, a successful complete granularityLevels lookup with exactly one matching item is authoritative for its ordered levels, dimensions, and context. Continue using those returned values without revalidating them through planningMeasureLevels or DimensionLevels; a missing dimension or LOV link in those separate lists does not block this branch. If the exact ID is absent, skip creation and report it as not found. A failed, malformed, ambiguous, or incomplete lookup still blocks creation; all other create validation and approval gates remain applicable.

For standalone_source_list_load, use find_planning_measure_by_id_or_name with the supplied measure name or MeasureId. If both are supplied they must identify the same item. Do not demand an internal ID when the name uniquely resolves. Require exactly one exact match across all pages before checking the parent's SourceType.
Resolve an existing Measure by exact MeasureId or unique exact Name across all pages. If both are supplied, require they identify the same record. Stop on zero or multiple exact matches.

Read the resolved Measure item through its returned item link using the selected workflow's read-only Fusion client. Capture every returned parent field, MeasureId, Name, authoritative IsSeeded, ObjectVersionNumber or other supported concurrency token, and response version metadata. Missing or ambiguous IsSeeded blocks update validation. For requested display UOM, display currency, or Price List changes, also read the complete current association sets for the exact MeasureId through the workflow-selected read-only client and returned child links, following pagination; failed, incomplete, or ambiguous sets block the child plan. For a requested context-level addition or removal, read the complete exact MeasureId/MeasureContextId row through the declared planningMeasureContextLevels finder, including MeasureContextLevelsList; zero rows permit an explicit addition only with confirmed create support, while a removal requires one row; multiple or incomplete rows block the change. For a requested existing conditional-format edit or deletion, read all MeasureConditionalFormat child pages, require every row to belong to the exact parent, resolve one requested rule unambiguously, and retain its full current values, returned `@context.key`, and child self link; missing or ambiguous identity or an incomplete read blocks the edit. Never place server-managed values in an update source. If no usable concurrency/version evidence is exposed, stop and report the missing contract.

After approved writes, read the Measure item and requested association child sets only for approved parent or association changes, completing pagination. For a level-only change, read the selected context-level row without requiring a parent readback. For an approved conditional-format edit, read the exact child again and verify its identity and complete final rule values. For an approved deletion, read the complete child set and verify the selected row is absent and all other rules are unchanged. For an approved context-level change, read the exact context result and compare its ordered MeasureContextLevelsList with the approved final levels; do not inspect parent GranularityId or MeasureContext as completion evidence. Use the approved level list and context-row baseline for a level-only comparison; use the approved parent change set, baseline/version evidence, and post-update parent values only when a parent update was requested. The live-session preview and approval stay in memory; do not require or persist an approval-envelope file. A lost session before submission requires fresh validation and approval; never replay an old approval.

Before update source preparation, invoke this BO as a validation POST, never as a GET lookup: use the workflow-selected core.fusion-api.rest-api-client to POST /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/planningMeasureValidateExpressions separately for each requested Expression and EditLockExpr. Send JSON with the resolved existing MeasureId, target Name, and exact text in Expression; send EditLockExpr text in Expression for its call. Inspect the Fusion response body regardless of HTTP status, including an HTTP error body exposed by the client. Read nonempty o:errorDetails[].detail strings, or a plain server message when no JSON detail is present; unwrap the client HTTP error prefix before comparing the server message. Pass only when every returned server message is exactly Expression is valid, with no conflicting message; skip only when neither field is requested. Display any other returned server message verbatim and stop. A transport failure without a readable server message or an empty or unreadable response blocks submission. Preserve each successful result and exact text for the immutable update payload.

Use read_standalone_source_list_parent through the selected read-only Fusion client to fetch the exact Measure item and current SourceType. Retain MeasureId, Name, SourceType, authoritative IsSeeded, item identity, and read timestamp. Seeded, unknown-status, missing, malformed, or mismatched details block both the parent handoff and child load.

Normalize an add/create data lookup or source-list request for an existing measure, including a supplied source-list Name and IsDefault, as requested SourceType 3 (List) without requiring the user to repeat that selection. Require authoritative non-seeded parent status first; a seeded or unknown-status parent blocks Source List addition and any SourceType handoff. Reject an explicitly conflicting SourceType 1 or 2. Require exact current parent SourceType 3 before a Source List child is prepared. If SourceType is 1 or 2, return update_required with the current MeasureId, Name, SourceType, and lookup evidence; do not build a child preview or start its load session before verified parent success. The caller must continue the same request through the selected update_planning_measure workflow to change SourceType to 3, with its normal validation and approval, then verify successful readback and re-enter this child branch carrying the original Name and IsDefault. Do not stop to ask whether the user also wants List; the lookup-addition request supplies that intent. This rule performs no parent write.

For a current SourceType 3 parent, use list_existing_planning_measure_source_lists to enumerate all children before approving a standalone child create. Preserve the exact returned rows for duplicate-name and default-row reconciliation. An unsupported or incomplete read blocks the child preview.

If Plan Types change, use list_measure_plan_types to read the edit's available ORA_MSC_SELECTOR_WORKAREA meanings; skip selections without a declared mapping and require an exact live match for each remaining mapped selection. Retain LookupCode as evidence only; map meanings to bit numbers during validation. If Plan Types do not change, return not_applicable without a live Plan Type request.

If SourceType changes, use list_measure_source_types to verify the requested live source-mode selection before field validation. If SourceType does not change, skip its source-type request. Before update field validation, resolve each requested display UOM code through list_planning_measure_uoms, each requested display currency code through list_planning_measure_currencies, and each requested Price List name through the complete list_planning_measure_price_lists result. Require exact unique matches, numeric PriceListId values, and complete pagination; retain lookup evidence. Return not_applicable only when SourceType and all three association groups are unchanged. A missing, ambiguous, failed, or incomplete lookup blocks validation.

Require one or more distinct requested changes. Require authoritative IsSeeded from the target baseline; if it is missing or ambiguous, fail validation. For a seeded target, reject requested changes to Name, Description, Editable, StoreResult or collected/refreshed flags, EditRange, measure groups or catalogs, RelevantPlanType, BaseUOMCode, BaseCurrencyCode, AggrOrder, AggrMethodTime, AggrMethodOther, WeightedBy, DisaggrMethodOther, DisaggrBasisOther, SecBasis, DecimalPlaces, SourceType or source level/attribute configuration, IsShared, DataTypeId, and GranularityId, plus any planningMeasureSourceLists action. Report each blocked field; do not omit it or replace it with a default. Unchanged required match/context values do not count as updates. Validate a requested context-level add/remove against the exact context row and live context/level lookups; calculate the complete ordered final MeasureContextLevelsList without dropping unrequested levels and require confirmed creation for a zero-row addition or POST/upsert behavior for one existing row; reject a zero-row removal or multiple rows. Validate remaining parent fields against the live planningMeasures update template and an explicitly requested conditional-format child edit or deletion against its live child update or delete metadata, with all applicable business/dependency rules. If Plan Types change, skip requested meanings or bit numbers without a declared mapping and record them as skipped. A mapped selection absent or ambiguous in the live lookup still blocks validation. If all requested selections are skipped, omit RelevantPlanType from the update change set. Otherwise calculate mapped bit values from selected meanings and preserve existing bits outside the available mapped meaning list with proposed = (existing & ~availableMask) OR selectedMask; include current mask, available meanings, selected meanings, preserved bits, and proposed integer in the result. MeasureId is only a match key when the update template requires it; ListId and ObjectVersionNumber are never update values. Reject server-managed, unsupported, invalid, or unapproved child fields and emit a separate result for every proposed field. For a changed Name require nonblank uniqueness outside the target MeasureId; apply the UOM, Currency, and Price List LOV, data-type, seeded/read-only, PRD plus ORG, deduplication, and exact payload-field rules to every requested association change. For every requested Expression or EditLockExpr require its exact successful server-validation evidence and exact proposed text; reject an adapter or template that cannot retain the field. For a requested existing conditional-format edit, require one exact child identity from the complete current child collection, apply the existing Basis/Threshold and Condition lookups to the proposed final rule, and require exactly one of Threshold or CompValue with a valid Color. Retain the returned `@context.key`, verify the unencoded batch-relative child path resolves to the same row and the selected adapter supports a child update part, and reject ambiguous identity, unsupported fields, or an unverified path; never convert an edit into a create. For display-association changes, compare the complete current and requested final association sets and require the selected batch adapter to support one parent update part plus child parts addressed through the resolved MeasureId: MeasureUOM, MeasureCurrency, and MeasurePriceList are create parts for the additions shown in the observed edit request. Construct each child path and payload from the requested field, resolved MeasureId, live LOV result, current association baseline, and selected batch adapter contract; do not require a captured UI request. Do not infer an action for removing or modifying an existing association. Retain only exact validated UomCode, CurrencyCode, and numeric PricelistId values in their respective child changes. For parent, display-association, and conditional-format changes, use the declared ADF batch version-root route and selected Run Book REST client in ../SKILL.md; verify supported part operations and live child payload fields. For context-level changes, use the separately declared planningMeasureContextLevels POST route and its validated full-list payload. Missing support or an unsupported child action blocks the affected change; do not substitute a Data Loader child row or an undeclared standalone child request. Do not require the user to supply an endpoint, headers, or prebuilt batch. Determine Editable from the selected Measure Value Type before reading EditRange. For an eligible editable target, use list_measure_edit_ranges and the Standard Defaults rule, then apply the Edit Range contract; preserve the resolved lookup value directly as EditRange and block any adapter or template that drops or transforms it. For a non-editable target omit EditRange without requiring a selection. When Measure Value Type is not changed, derive its effective selection from the authoritative baseline; never interpret an omitted update input as non-editable. Retain unchanged EditRange outside the parent update change set, and never introduce a default or clear for a seeded or read-only target.

Apply the EditRange design gate before source preparation and again against the final immutable source before submission. For an existing target require authoritative seeded and read-only status; unknown eligibility blocks the change. Never change EditRange for seeded or read-only measures, including defaulting or clearing. Omit EditRange when Measure Value Type does not select Editable. For an eligible editable target carry the input-validation result directly as EditRange with its resolved type; reject a missing, replaced, or transformed value. This node performs no write.

Build a complete approval-bound change summary for all requested fields: current and proposed values, per-field validation outcomes, resolved MeasureId and Measure Name, full parent baseline, concurrency/version metadata, and exact intended parent update when one is needed. When display associations change, construct one immutable batch plan with the parent update first, followed by a create part for each newly requested validated display-UOM, display-currency, and price-list association at its confirmed planningMeasures child path. Omit unchanged associations and unrelated UI-save parts; bind exact lookup-resolved values and live-schema-required child fields to the plan. For an existing conditional-format edit, add only the validated child update part after the parent, using the verified unencoded batch-relative path built from the selected row's returned `@context.key` and the final rule values required by the live update schema. Retain an explicit null for the superseded Threshold or CompValue when the update contract requires it; no child create is implied. For an explicitly requested conditional-format deletion, add a child delete part after the parent at the verified path from the returned `@context.key` with an empty payload; preserve other rules. For a requested context-level change, retain a separate approval-bound POST plan for planningMeasureContextLevels with exact MeasureContextId, MeasureId, and complete final MeasureContextLevelsList; omit the parent batch when no other parent or association change remains. Preserve unchanged source-list rows outside the plan and compare the complete current and proposed association sets before preview. Recheck the immutable change plan against the EditRange design gate and validated lookup evidence; omit retained unchanged EditRange and reject any unapproved EditRange change.
Return only the requested find_planning_measure_by_id_or_name lookup result; no write
Return only the requested find_planning_measure_group_by_id_or_name lookup result; no write
Return only the requested list_planning_measures_in_group lookup result; no write
Return the unique exact CatalogId and Name with complete-page lookup evidence; no create, association, or write.
Return GranularityId, MeasureContextId, ordered LevelName/LevelId pairs, GranLevelIds, and GranDimensions; no write

Use list_measure_plan_types before direct-level measure creation. Skip selections without a declared meaning-to-bit mapping and record the skipped selections. Require at least one remaining mapped selection and one exact live ORA_MSC_SELECTOR_WORKAREA Meaning for every mapped selected Plan Type; retain LookupCode only as lookup evidence for the subsequent bit-number validation.

Use list_measure_plan_types after resolving GranularityId and before creating the measure. Skip selections without a declared meaning-to-bit mapping and record the skipped selections. Require at least one remaining mapped selection and one exact live ORA_MSC_SELECTOR_WORKAREA Meaning for every mapped selected Plan Type; retain LookupCode only as lookup evidence for the subsequent bit-number validation.

Build the context-specific list from supplied measure levels, build a retained Default-context LevelsList or Item fallback for contexts 2 and 3, set GranularityId to null for an ordinary create or a verified duplicate level-based fallback, then synchronize dependencies and apply omitted-field defaults. If no source-list rows and no explicit SourceType are supplied, set SourceType to 1 (None) before conditional-format validation. Preserve an explicit source mode; validate any level-source configuration against the resulting mode. Determine whether a Measure Value Type was selected before EditRange defaulting; expression-only creation may leave it unset. Apply the EditRange Standard Default only for an eligible editable target with absent input and confirmed LOV value 2; never default an explicitly blank value or a non-editable, seeded, or read-only target. For a create handoff originating from duplication, preserve the exact copied DisaggrMethodOther before synchronizing dependencies. Selecting Editable or Collected and Refreshed must not replace it with EQUAL; exclude duplicate handoffs from the Allocation Type default. For duplicate origin with verified source-granularity preservation support, retain the exact source GranularityId instead of setting it to null. The duplicate contract takes precedence over ordinary create clearing and granularity defaults. Retain resolved levels/context as validation evidence and include them only as supported by the selected adapter; do not replace the copied granularity during dependency synchronization. An unsupported adapter requires a verified equivalent level-based fallback, otherwise stop.  For an explicit context-level projection originating from a Project or Planning Attribute duplicate, use the completed CPA.RESOLVE_DUPLICATE_DEFAULT_LEVELS evidence as supplied-level creation: retain requested context, its full ordered context list, and Default-context subset or evidenced Item fallback; clear GranularityId for this verified level-based strategy. Do not restore the parent Default-context GranularityId, default it to 135, erase the context list, or reroute to parent-granularity creation.
A custom planning-measure create request uses supplied conditional-format rules after the direct-level defaulting path. Validate every supplied rule; an empty rule set is not applicable.

Validate the parent planning-measure create fields after conditional-format rules. Skip Plan Type meanings or bit numbers with no declared mapping; retain skipped selections in validation evidence and require at least one mapped, live-validated selection. For the remaining selected Plan Type meanings, OR their mapped 1 << (bitNumber - 1) values into one integer RelevantPlanType; retain the per-meaning calculation and reject comma-separated codes. Before SourceType classification, require a nonblank unique Name from a complete measure lookup; resolve every supplied UOM, Currency, and Price List through its live LOV; allow BaseUOMCode only for Number and BaseCurrencyCode only for Currency on a non-seeded, non-read-only measure without both PRD and ORG; omit or null inapplicable unsupplied bases and reject explicitly invalid bases. Reject display UOM/currency items for Percent, Date, or Text; deduplicate codes and numeric PricelistId values; construct only Name, BaseUOMCode, MeasureUOM.items[].UomCode, BaseCurrencyCode, MeasureCurrency.items[].CurrencyCode, and numeric MeasurePriceList.items[].PricelistId for this field group; never send display names, PriceListName, or Source List ListId. Omit optional unsupplied fields and set an inapplicable unsupplied base to null only when the selected adapter supports that shape. Require either one supported Measure Value Type selection, Editable (Editable and Persistent) or Collected and Refreshed, or a nonblank Expression. Block creation when both Measure Value Type and Expression are absent. Allow a server-validated Expression without a Measure Value Type selection, and allow an Expression alongside a valid selection; do not invent or default a Measure Value Type for expression-only creation. Editable maps to Editable=1 without requiring StoreResult; Collected and Refreshed maps to StoreResult=1 without requiring Editable. Reject contradictory explicit selections. Then classify SourceType. Require a matching successful server-validation result for every requested Expression and EditLockExpr, and preserve their exact text in the parent create source; block if the adapter or template omits either field. Determine Editable from the selected Measure Value Type before reading EditRange. For an eligible editable target, use list_measure_edit_ranges and the Standard Defaults rule, then apply the Edit Range contract; preserve the resolved lookup value directly as EditRange and block any adapter or template that drops or transforms it. For a non-editable target omit EditRange without requiring a selection. For duplicate origin, enforce the approved granularity strategy: preserved GranularityId must equal the authoritative source value, have matching resolved levels/context, and be retained by the selected create adapter. The ordinary granularity-clearing/default rule is inapplicable to that strategy. A dropped or changed value blocks the create source. A level-based fallback is permitted only with verified equivalent-dimensionality evidence; no preservation or verified fallback blocks submission. Require Measure-catalog, Measure-group, and Plan-type assignments before preparing the create source or duplicate handoff; omission, blank selections, empty lists, or unresolved values in any required group block creation. Measure-catalog assignment is required: an omitted selection is allowed only when valid copied non-seeded associations satisfy duplication; an explicit blank, empty, or unresolved selection blocks creation. Require at least one resolved catalog before source preparation. If the required Measure Catalog is omitted, blank, empty, or absent after seeded duplicate associations are excluded, stop the current create or duplicate handoff immediately with input_validation and report: Creation blocked: a valid Measure Catalog is required. Do not ask a question, prompt for a catalog selection, or continue source preparation, preview, approval, or submission in that run. Resolve every supplied nonblank catalog name through find_planning_measure_catalog_by_name; missing, ambiguous, or unresolved supplied catalogs still block creation. For duplication, preserve and validate non-seeded source catalog associations when present; if none remain after seeded associations are excluded, require a valid catalog selection. Use find_planning_measure_catalog_by_name, list_planning_measure_groups, and the existing live Plan Type validation for required assignments. If Measure Catalog is missing, report only the required catalog error and stop; otherwise report missing Measure Group and Plan Type together. Never infer or default a catalog, group, or plan-type association.  For duplicate origin, retain the authoritative MeasureCalculationType value and metadata-required type through create source and readback; do not copy source GoalValues or block or report on its omission by Data Loader. Retain RestAction=POST solely as an ADF_REST loader control on every create row, including copied associations; omit it from Fusion REST JSON payloads. Apply the Duplicate payload field contract in this file: require live ADF_REST loader/import support, RestAction in its schema and POST in each create row; block missing/wrong controls or unsupported metadata, without requiring proof of server-internal JSON transformation.

Apply the EditRange design gate before source preparation and again against the final immutable source before submission. For an existing target require authoritative seeded and read-only status; unknown eligibility blocks the change. Never change EditRange for seeded or read-only measures, including defaulting or clearing. Omit EditRange when Measure Value Type does not select Editable. For an eligible editable target carry the input-validation result directly as EditRange with its resolved type; reject a missing, replaced, or transformed value. This node performs no write.
A create-measure input-validation rule fails.

Use the exact granularity item's MeasureContextId as the create context without asking the user. Convert resolved ordered GranLevelIds to that context's list, build a retained Default-context LevelsList or Item fallback for contexts 2 and 3, set GranularityId to null for an ordinary create or a verified duplicate level-based fallback, then synchronize dependencies and apply omitted-field defaults. If no source-list rows and no explicit SourceType are supplied, set SourceType to 1 (None) before conditional-format validation. Preserve an explicit source mode; validate any level-source configuration against the resulting mode. Determine whether a Measure Value Type was selected before EditRange defaulting; expression-only creation may leave it unset. Apply the EditRange Standard Default only for an eligible editable target with absent input and confirmed LOV value 2; never default an explicitly blank value or a non-editable, seeded, or read-only target. For a create handoff originating from duplication, preserve the exact copied DisaggrMethodOther before synchronizing dependencies. Selecting Editable or Collected and Refreshed must not replace it with EQUAL; exclude duplicate handoffs from the Allocation Type default. For duplicate origin with verified source-granularity preservation support, retain the exact source GranularityId instead of setting it to null. The duplicate contract takes precedence over ordinary create clearing and granularity defaults. Retain resolved levels/context as validation evidence and include them only as supported by the selected adapter; do not replace the copied granularity during dependency synchronization. An unsupported adapter requires a verified equivalent level-based fallback, otherwise stop.  For an explicit context-level projection originating from a Project or Planning Attribute duplicate, use the completed CPA.RESOLVE_DUPLICATE_DEFAULT_LEVELS evidence as supplied-level creation: retain requested context, its full ordered context list, and Default-context subset or evidenced Item fallback; clear GranularityId for this verified level-based strategy. Do not restore the parent Default-context GranularityId, default it to 135, erase the context list, or reroute to parent-granularity creation.
A custom planning-measure create request uses supplied conditional-format rules after levels are derived from GranularityId. Validate every supplied rule; an empty rule set is not applicable.

Validate a parent planning-measure create request after levels are derived from GranularityId. Skip Plan Type meanings or bit numbers with no declared mapping; retain skipped selections in validation evidence and require at least one mapped, live-validated selection. For the remaining selected Plan Type meanings, OR their mapped 1 << (bitNumber - 1) values into one integer RelevantPlanType; retain the per-meaning calculation and reject comma-separated codes.
